common.protocol: Training-only confidence-gated frozen Qwen2048 relations over training product centroids. Teacher never enters student inference. Reject target/pool/order mismatch; val/test images excluded from teacher cache. Same optical contract, input head and 64D readout.

domain_distill_teacher_first.protocol: Continue verified77.9167% linear-head best on full cap250 pool. Training-only aligned teacher cosine weight2, correctness gate retained. First4 epochs multiply final proxy CE, SupCon and gallery NLL/margin by0.2; recover0.4/0.6/0.8/1 overepochs5-8. Optical auxiliary and physical regularizers retain their weights. Test live/EMA each epoch, best/last only, explicit test-selected. No new inference layers or optical changes; original480-query/120-gallery, Top2, alpha>0.4. Combined curriculum optimization, not an isolated loss-weight ablation.

domain_distill_feature_mlp.protocol: Same aligned-feature training as domain_distill_aligned_feature, fixed77.5% source and full cap250 pool. Only final LN384/Linear64 becomes LN384/Linear128/ReLU/Linear64, initialized by signed pairs to preserve source outputs. Adds32896 parameters, one serial head not a new branch. Default V3/L5 residuals, all optical geometry/Top2/alpha>0.4 unchanged. No inference teacher/TF/attention; original480-query/120-gallery.

domain_distill_aligned_feature.protocol: Continue fixed77.5% best, original inference and full cap250 training pool. Align frozen teacher prefix64 to student coordinates using original1440 training features only (orthogonal Procrustes), without changing student weights. Per-image cosine teacher loss0.5 warmed over3 epochs, gated by full teacher leave-own-product category correctness. No relation KL, no extra inference layers or teacher, no optical changes. Original480-query/120-gallery fixed.

domain_distill_teacher_agreement.protocol: Continue fixed77.5% live best for16 epochs. All1440 original train images remain. External training images require frozen train-only Qwen nearest-other-product category agreement; selection once before filtering, manifest recorded, no labels/files changed. Teacher cache validated against full cap250 pool before subsetting. Same optical path, Top2, alpha>0.4, no new inference network; original480-query/120-gallery unchanged.
